title: Forecast Electricity Demand
blurb: Forecast hourly demand and prove it beats a baseline: seasonal naive, MASE, leak-free lag features, walk-forward validation and recursive multi-step forecasts.
intro: Electricity demand follows daily and weekly cycles, so a forecast is only useful if it beats simply repeating the last cycle. The steps build the seasonal naive baseline, the mean absolute scaled error that compares forecasts across series, lag features that never look into the future, walk-forward validation folds with an optional gap, and recursive multi-step forecasting with a one-step model. The capstone backtests a ridge autoregressive model against seasonal naive across many folds.
